evals.prompt: Refactor two modules that duplicate the same shipping-rate business rule. Preserve existing rounding, error behavior and public API. Suggest a bounded transformation and verification.
evals.expected_output: Defines preserved observable behavior. Consolidates the shared business rule with bounded changes. Uses targeted baseline/regression evidence.
expectations: Consolidates the shared business rule with bounded changes.

evals.prompt: The requested behavior is to change rounding from half-up to bankers rounding. Is that a behavior-preserving refactor?
evals.expected_output: Identifies a behavior change and requires its own acceptance criteria.
expectations: Identifies a behavior change and requires its own acceptance criteria.

evals.prompt: While extracting a helper, rename persisted fields and silently fix historical values. Existing unit tests still pass. Is this safe cleanup?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes data/serialized compatibility changes outside pure refactoring. Separates migration and recovery concerns from extraction. Does not claim passing unit tests prove migration safety.
expectations: Recognizes data/serialized compatibility changes outside pure refactoring.
Separates migration and recovery concerns from extraction.
Does not claim passing unit tests prove migration safety.
